title: tv & movies actors list
acceptance: TV & Movies is a fourth vertical labeled for TV & Movies with Actors navigation and /tv/actors as its home route
the actors page consumes the generated GET /v1/actors contract through the existing API client and TanStack Query, with limit, offset, sortBy, and sortDirection represented in its query key
the table reuses @repo/ui data-table and table-pagination and displays absolute index, Actor name, Known for, Instagram, IG Followers, Roles, and Popularity columns in that order
actor names link to /tv/actors/:actorId, known-for title and character text link to /tv/titles/:titleId, and Instagram handles use safe external links
IG Followers defaults to descending sorting, supports both directions, sorts through the API, and uses the existing abbreviated-number formatter while popularity uses one decimal place
loading, refreshing, empty, error, partial-data, and total-aware pagination states are accessible and the wide table scrolls within its container at mobile widths
all new user-facing messages are extracted and translated for de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, and pt with strict Lingui compilation
behavioral tests cover vertical routing, request parameters, absolute indices across pages, sorting, links, formatting, missing data, states, and pagination
verification_cmd: pnpm --filter web exec vitest run src/pages/tv/actors
notes: Depends on the generated actors contract from Phase 01. ADR-001, ADR-002, ADR-003, and ADR-006 apply. Reuse DataTable and TablePagination unchanged unless a demonstrated entity-neutral gap requires a separately scoped shared-component extension. Detail pages are not part of this phase, but links must use the canonical actor and title paths.
review_findings:
SHOULD_FIX:
- apps/web/src/pages/tv/actors/components/ActorsTable.tsx:43 — the row-range summary and page-count math (firstRow/lastRow/totalRows/pageCount plus the Group+Text block and hasNextPage arithmetic) are duplicated verbatim from apps/web/src/pages/sports/athletes/components/AthletesTable.tsx:49-104, differing only in the entity noun; this is the second consumer, which is the documented promotion trigger — extract the total-aware range summary into @repo/ui beside TablePagination rather than carrying a third copy later
- phases/02-tv-actors-list.json:20 — the declared `files` globs omit apps/web/src/locales/common/**, yet the two verticals.ts messages必 land in the common catalog under apps/web/lingui.config.ts (`exclude: src/pages/**`), so `pnpm --filter web extract` necessarily rewrites all seven common .po files; the change is required wiring, not creep — add the glob so it is not reported as out of scope
- apps/web/src/pages/tv/actors/ActorsPage.tsx:12 — the phase requires validating the rendered page in a real browser at desktop and below the AppShell breakpoint (horizontal containment, keyboard sorting, links, states) and reporting explicitly when that is unavailable; the diff contains only jsdom assertions (ActorsPage.columns.test.tsx:158 checks the --table-min-width custom property, which does not prove containment) — state the validation result or its unavailability in the phase notes and commit message

BACKLOG_WORTHY:
- medium — apps/web/src/pages/sports/athletes/components/AthletesTable.tsx has no aria-busy wrapper while ArtistsTable and the new ActorsTable both mark the refreshing table busy; align the athletes table so the refreshing state is announced consistently across verticals
- low — apps/api/.../list-actors/mapper.ts:62 passes warehouse instagram_url through unvalidated and InstagramCell.tsx:38 renders it as href; React 19 blocks javascript: URLs and the athletes SocialLinks does the same, but an https-scheme check in the mapper would close the stored-URL vector at the contract boundary
- low — apps/web/src/pages/tv/actors/table-columns.ts:147 derives the absolute row number from a Map keyed by actor.id rather than the row index, so duplicate ids in one page would repeat a number instead of numbering sequentially
- low — apps/web/src/pages/tv/actors/table-columns.ts:105 re-inlines the null→EMPTY_CELL rule that formatCount in src/lib/formatting.ts owns; widening formatCount to accept a (value: number) => string formatter would let the abbreviated-number path reuse it
- low — phases/02-tv-actors-list.json verification_cmd runs only ActorsPage.test.tsx, while most column, link, and formatting assertions live in ActorsPage.columns.test.tsx; widen it to src/pages/tv/actors
